title: Meta joins with group of companies to tame ‘chaos’ of doing business with AI bots
summary: Meta, in collaboration with Bret Taylor's startup Sierra, is working on establishing a set of technological standards aimed at streamlining interactions with AI bots. This initiative seeks to mitigate the complexities and unpredictabilities that businesses face when integrating AI into their operations. By creating a unified framework, Meta and its partners hope to enhance the efficiency and reliability of AI-driven business processes.
